summary.text: Jon Weber is a Republican who represents District 34 (Seat A) in the Idaho House of Representatives and is listed in a third term; the directory lists Weber as a small business owner.

paragraphs.text: According to the legislature's biography, Weber was raised in Michigan, attended Ricks College and Utah State University, and owned and operated a small business for 30 years.
It says Weber served 12 years as a Madison County commissioner and is a past president of the Idaho Association of County Commissioners and Clerks.
